note: ORPHAN Pro 31:24 — she makes linen garments and sells them; she delivers sashes to the merchant.

dims.v: productive trade — making and selling, supplying the merchant

the making of linen garments to sell and the delivering of sashes to the merchant — the productive enterprise that turns skill and industry into trade, the capable woman's work reaching beyond the home into the market
the industry that makes, sells, and supplies, turning skill into gain

natan (give/deliver) — 'she makes linen garments and sells them; she DELIVERS sashes to the merchant' (31:24); her enterprise is productive and outward-facing, her skilled work becoming trade. Industry joined to commerce marks the capable woman (cf 31:16, 18).
